card.name: Metabolic disorder drug dosing text
card.fires_on: Words and spaces in dosing passages for metabolic-disorder drugs (sapropterin, urea cycle therapies), such as partway through sapropterin or ornithine, or just before a dose number or table number.

modes.label: Inside drug and enzyme names
modes.description: Partway through names like sapropterin and ornithine transcarbamylase.

modes.label: Linking words and spaces before dose
modes.description: A small word or space just before a dose, table number or drug name in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Protein restriction
modes.description: The word protein in diet-restriction phrases.
modes.example: not adequately controlled with<< protein>> restriction
